Welcome to the Neon Model Grand Prix! In this futuristic ML competition visualization, seven cutting-edge architectures race through a simulated track that includes real-time data drift, noise spikes, and robustness checkpoints. Each lap rewards performance, stability, and generalization—so the fastest model isn’t always the winner.

Which competitor will cross the finish line first? Comment your pick and watch the full race updates.
